pages.pageTitle: Private Experiences Bali | Culinary & Celebration Experiences
pages.pagePurpose: Hub page that introduces the six curated private experiences and drives visitors to the specific experience page that matches their occasion.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Informational + transactional: users researching private villa experiences in Bali and looking for options.
pages.targetCustomer: Villa holidaymakers, celebration planners, corporate retreat organisers, and families seeking unique in-villa activities.
pages.emotionalObjective: Inspire curiosity and confidence that myCHEF can turn an ordinary villa evening into a memorable, fully-managed experience.
pages.mainConversionGoal: Click through to a specific experience page or start a WhatsApp enquiry.

heroImage.concept: A wide hero showing an elegant villa terrace at golden hour with a beautifully set table, subtle service activity, and tropical greenery suggesting multiple experiences.
heroImage.necessarySetting: Luxury Bali villa terrace/pool deck with jungle or rice-terrace backdrop.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, centre-weighted, safe margin on left for headline overlay.

supportingImages.concept: Six card images, each showing the specific activity in a villa setting: cocktail bar, sushi lesson, cooking class, kids cooking, oyster station, romantic table.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa kitchen, poolside bar, garden pavilion, dining terrace.
supportingImages.timeOfDay: Mixed: afternoon for classes, sunset for parties, evening for proposal/oysters.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Each card image must visually match the title and description of the experience it links to.
supportingImages.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, safe at centre for card cropping.

globalExclusions: No invented awards, uniforms with logos, or vehicle branding.
pages.notes: The hub hero should feel inclusive and aspirational without focusing on a single experience. Keep the six card images visually consistent (colour temperature, lighting, villa style).

pages.pageTitle: Bartender Hire Bali | Private Cocktail Party in Your Villa
pages.pagePurpose: Sell bartender hire and private cocktail party experiences at Bali villas.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Transactional: users looking to hire a bartender or host a cocktail party in Bali.
pages.targetCustomer: Villa hosts celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, corporate retreats, or villa welcomes.
pages.emotionalObjective: Convey effortless sophistication, social energy, and professional service that lets the host be a guest.
pages.mainConversionGoal: WhatsApp enquiry with date, villa, and guest count.

heroImage.concept: A bartender pouring a crafted cocktail at a stylish mobile bar by a villa pool at sunset, with elegant glassware and tropical garnishes.
heroImage.necessarySetting: Bali villa poolside terrace with sunset light and tropical planting.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, bartender right of centre, leave left clear for headline overlay.

supportingImages.concept: Close-up of cocktails and canapés arranged on a bar or passing tray.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa bar counter or poolside table.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Illustrates the 'Cocktails & Canapés' section and supports the menu description.

supportingImages.concept: Bartender team setting up a mobile bar before guests arrive.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the planning and end-to-end management narrative.

supportingImages.concept: Elegant mobile bar detail shot.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Reinforces the investment/premium positioning without showing prices.

pages.notes: Use warm, golden lighting consistent with sunset parties. Keep bartender attire neutral and professional.

pages.pageTitle: Sushi Making Class Bali | Private In-Villa Masterclass
pages.pagePurpose: Sell private in-villa sushi making classes.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Transactional: users searching for sushi classes or cooking experiences in Bali villas.
pages.targetCustomer: Couples, families, and small groups of friends seeking a hands-on culinary activity.
pages.emotionalObjective: Convey craftsmanship, intimacy, and the pleasure of learning a refined skill in a private setting.
pages.mainConversionGoal: WhatsApp enquiry with group size, villa, and preferred date.

heroImage.concept: A chef's hands shaping nigiri at a clean villa kitchen counter, with fresh fish and sushi rice visible, soft natural light.
necessaryPeople: 1 chef (hands/forearms in frame, face optional soft focus)
heroImage.necessarySetting: Modern Bali villa kitchen island with natural materials.
heroImage.timeOfDay: Morning or early afternoon soft daylight.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, hands/counter lower centre, leave upper-left clear for text.

supportingImages.concept: Chef demonstrating slicing technique to a small group at a villa counter.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Illustrates the hands-on instruction described.

supportingImages.concept: Overhead or 45-degree shot of fresh sushi ingredients neatly arranged.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the 'What You Will Learn' and fresh-ingredients narrative.

supportingImages.concept: Guests enjoying sushi they made at a villa dining table.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa dining table with tropical view blurred in background.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Shows the social, celebratory outcome of the class.

globalExclusions: No visible fish species claims beyond what can be sourced.
pages.notes: Lighting should be bright and clean to emphasise freshness. Avoid overly styled 'advertisement' looks.

pages.pageTitle: Private Cooking Class Bali | Chef at Your Villa
pages.pagePurpose: Sell private Balinese and Indonesian cooking classes at villas.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Transactional: users wanting a private cooking class in Bali.
pages.targetCustomer: Couples, families, friend groups, and food-curious travellers wanting hands-on cultural learning.
pages.emotionalObjective: Convey authenticity, discovery, and the satisfaction of cooking and eating a meal you learned to make.
pages.mainConversionGoal: WhatsApp enquiry with villa, group size, and preferred class.

heroImage.concept: A chef teaching guests to prepare Balinese spice paste by hand in a villa kitchen, with vibrant local ingredients spread across the counter.
heroImage.necessarySetting: Open-plan Bali villa kitchen with tropical light.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, action in lower-right, leave left for headline overlay.

supportingImages.concept: Colourful Balinese ingredients and spice pastes prepared for a class.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the Balinese/Indonesian class menu descriptions.

supportingImages.concept: Chef selecting fresh produce at a local Balinese morning market.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Illustrates the optional sunrise market add-on.

supportingImages.concept: Group sitting down to eat the meal they cooked at a villa table.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa dining area with garden view.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Reinforces the social and celebratory use cases.

globalExclusions: No invented village or market names.
pages.notes: Lean into warm, natural daylight and authentic Balinese produce. Keep villa interiors contemporary but clearly Bali.

pages.pageTitle: Kids Birthday Party Bali | Private Chef Party
pages.pagePurpose: Sell private chef-hosted kids birthday parties at Bali villas.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Transactional: parents planning a kids birthday party in Bali.
pages.targetCustomer: Parents of children aged 3–12 staying in Bali villas who want a hosted activity and meal.
pages.emotionalObjective: Convey fun, safety, and stress-free hosting — children engaged, parents relaxed.
pages.mainConversionGoal: WhatsApp enquiry with villa, date, number of children, and preferred menu.

heroImage.concept: Children around a villa poolside table decorating pizzas or cupcakes with a chef, balloons and tropical décor in soft background.
heroImage.necessarySetting: Bali villa poolside pavilion or terrace.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, children lower centre, leave top-left clear for headline.

supportingImages.concept: Close-up of children's hands topping personal pizzas or decorating cupcakes.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa table with craft-paper or simple tablecloth.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the six interactive menu descriptions.

supportingImages.concept: Family-friendly birthday table with fresh food and safe portions.
necessaryPeople: 1–2 adults and children in soft background
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the allergen safety messaging.

globalExclusions: No identifiable children's faces in sharp focus.
pages.notes: Keep tones bright and joyful. Show diversity in children. Avoid overly staged party scenes.

pages.pageTitle: Oyster Bar Bali | Champagne & Oyster Experience
pages.pagePurpose: Sell a private champagne and oyster experience at Bali villas.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Transactional: users seeking luxury oyster bar or champagne service in Bali.
pages.targetCustomer: Couples and small groups celebrating anniversaries, birthdays, pre-dinner receptions, or indulgent afternoons.
pages.emotionalObjective: Convey refined indulgence, exclusivity, and effortless luxury.
pages.mainConversionGoal: WhatsApp enquiry with date, villa, and guest count.

heroImage.concept: A waiter pouring champagne beside an ice bed of fresh oysters at a villa poolside bar at sunset.
heroImage.necessarySetting: Bali villa terrace/pool deck with sunset glow.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, station right of centre, leave left for headline overlay.

supportingImages.concept: Mediterranean seafood and oyster station setup before guests arrive.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Shows the setup and service detail described.

supportingImages.concept: Champagne being poured into a flute at an elegant Bali villa event.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the champagne pairing section.

globalExclusions: No claims about specific oyster varieties unless confirmed available.
pages.notes: Use warm sunset tones and elegant styling. Keep the mood intimate, not party-like.

pages.pageTitle: Proposal Package Bali | Romantic Proposal Dinner
pages.pagePurpose: Sell bespoke romantic proposal dinners with private chef service at Bali villas.
pages.primarySearchIntent: Transactional: users planning a proposal or romantic dinner in Bali.
pages.targetCustomer: Individuals planning to propose or couples celebrating honeymoons/anniversaries who want a private, styled dinner.
pages.emotionalObjective: Convey intimacy, perfection, and discreet orchestration of a once-in-a-lifetime moment.
pages.mainConversionGoal: Confidential WhatsApp enquiry with date, villa, and vision.

heroImage.concept: A candlelit table for two on a villa terrace at dusk, with flowers, champagne, and a subtle tropical view — no people, only the promise of the moment.
heroImage.necessarySetting: Bali villa clifftop or garden terrace at dusk.
heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, table centre-right, left margin for headline overlay.

supportingImages.concept: Elegant plated dish from a romantic dinner.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the bespoke menu description without claiming a fixed menu.

supportingImages.concept: Romantic candlelit dinner setting prepared for a proposal.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa terrace with candles and flowers.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Reinforces the discreet, perfectly timed proposal coordination.

globalExclusions: No text on dessert plates unless requested by client.
pages.notes: Hero should feel cinematic but private. Avoid showing a ring box unless it is a client request; focus on the setting.

heroImage.recommendedCropBehaviour: object-cover, chef right of centre, left clear for headline overlay.

supportingImages.concept: Open-plan living and pool area of a luxury Bali villa prepared for guests.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the promise of a perfectly prepared villa.

supportingImages.concept: Uniformed chauffeur opening the door of a black luxury vehicle at a villa entrance.

supportingImages.concept: Elegant villa wedding or event reception table.
supportingImages.necessarySetting: Villa lawn or terrace at dusk.

supportingImages.concept: Uniformed waiters providing polished in-villa service.

supportingImages.concept: Immaculately reset dining tablescape after an event.
supportingImages.relationshipToCopy: Supports the cleanup/handback promise.

globalExclusions: No vehicle branding beyond what is real.
pages.notes: Maintain a calm, premium palette across all chapter images. Each chapter image should feel like part of one continuous stay.
